};
const trace = {
  type: "choropleth",
  locationmode: "ISO-3",
  locations: data.iso3_codes,
  z: data.color,
  colorscale: [[0, "#EAEAEA"], [1, "#FFB6C1"]],

  zmax: 1,
  showscale: false
};
const layout = {

};
Plotly.newPlot("map-leo", [trace], layout);
</script>



## Tổng quan về thành phần hóa học

Loài *Rosa centifolia* đã phân lập và xác định được 27 hoạt chất thuộc  về 5 nhóm gồm benzene and substituted derivatives, fatty acyls, oxanes, prenol lipids, saturated hydrocarbons. Cấu trúc của từng nhóm trình bày chi tiết dưới đây.

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/smiles-drawer@2.0.1/dist/smiles-drawer.min.js"></script>
<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const molecules = [
        {id: "canvas_Row0", smiles: "CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC" },
{id: "canvas_Row1", smiles: "C=CC(C)(O)CCC=C(C)C" },
{id: "canvas_Row2", smiles: "CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC" },
{id: "canvas_Row3", smiles: "CC(=O)OC/C=C(\C)CCC=C(C)C" },
{id: "canvas_Row4", smiles: "CC1CCC(C(C)C)C(O)C1" },
{id: "canvas_Row5", smiles: "CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC" },
{id: "canvas_Row6", smiles: "C=CC(=C)CCC=C(C)C" },
{id: "canvas_Row7", smiles: "CC(C)=CCC/C(C)=C\CC/C(C)=C/CO" },
{id: "canvas_Row8", smiles: "OCCc1ccccc1" },
{id: "canvas_Row9", smiles: "CC(C)=CCCC(C)=CC=O" },
{id: "canvas_Row10", smiles: "CC(=O)OC/C=C(/C)CCC=C(C)C" },
{id: "canvas_Row11", smiles: "CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC" },
{id: "canvas_Row12", smiles: "CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC" },
{id: "canvas_Row13", smiles: "CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC" },
{id: "canvas_Row14", smiles: "CC(=O)OCCC(C)CCC=C(C)C" },
{id: "canvas_Row15", smiles: "CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC" },
{id: "canvas_Row16", smiles: "CC(C)=C[C@H]1C[C@H](C)CCO1" },
{id: "canvas_Row17", smiles: "CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC" },
{id: "canvas_Row18", smiles: "CC(C)=CCC/C(C)=C\C=O" },
{id: "canvas_Row19", smiles: "CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC" },
{id: "canvas_Row20", smiles: "CC(C)=CCC/C(C)=C/CO" },
{id: "canvas_Row21", smiles: "CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC" },
{id: "canvas_Row22", smiles: "CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC" },
{id: "canvas_Row23", smiles: "CC(C)=CCCC(C)=CCCC(C)=CCO" },
{id: "canvas_Row24", smiles: "CC(C)=CCC/C(C)=C\CO" },
{id: "canvas_Row25", smiles: "CC(C)=CCCC(C)CCO" },
{id: "canvas_Row26", smiles: "CC(C)=CC1CC(C)CCO1" }
    ];
    const drawer = new SmilesDrawer.Drawer({ width: 150, height: 150 });
    molecules.forEach(mol => {
      SmilesDrawer.parse(mol.smiles, function (tree) {
        drawer.draw(tree, mol.id, "light", false);
      });
    });
  });
</script>
